plan.status_of_folds: the five outer folds were used by V5/V6; V7.1 five-fold numbers are internal estimates; the new confirmation set below is the only untouched evaluation
plan.primary_endpoint: disease macro end-to-end Recall@10 over the fixed evaluation background; multi-seed: per run per disease first, then averaged (never a union of hits)

E1.task: outer cold start, 4,238 five-fold diseases, 5 folds x 3 seeds
methods: V6 LightGBM (archived V6 main scorer, read from runs_v6)
retrieval-channel-only LightGBM on the V6 500 (re-registered strong control, 3 seeds)
same-resource fixed fusion (zero-training SapBERT/HPA/ESM similarities, weights on dev)
multimodal core alone (own 500 list, degree-prior fill marked)
late fusion, non-negative fixed (F7 + core, weight on dev)
late fusion, LightGBM on the OOF work pool (V6 500 U core top-500)
raw concatenation of modality vectors into LightGBM
core without / with anchor alignment (lambda_A flipped)

E3.strict_variant: anchor training restricted to association-warm genes of the context (stricter gene-supervision cold); cold genes keep frozen features only

cells.new resources, old method: LightGBM on the V6 500 + raw V7.1 modality vectors
cells.old resources, new method: late fusion with a core on GO function + GTEx expression (no ESM, no HPA)
cells.new resources, new method: late fusion with the full core

checks: paired permutations (sequence: length+degree; function: annotation depth+degree; tissue weights: tissue count+broad flag)

comparisons: old V6 500 fixed, only the score changes
new hits and squeezed-out old hits

parts: V6 support task kept as archived
small support sets (k = 1, diseases with 2-5 known genes) with the V6 support line and an optional core term whose weight is set on dev (0 allowed)
new confirmation set (frozen below), every method evaluated once

E8.image: HPA DenseNet image features (obtained); controls: localisation-only, within-cell-line image-gene permutation, cell-line-centred features
E8.mouse: IMPC calls + MGI 1:1 homology + MGI curated MP-HP SSSOM; directional match S(d,m); enabled only if the programmatic mapping checks pass; manual spot check exported, not performed

admission_rules.core_config: one-SE rule on fold-0 dev, simplest first (rank, gate, lambda_A)
admission_rules.modality_kept: paired permutation lowers dev Recall@10 by > 1 paired SE
admission_rules.late_fusion: core enters late fusion iff it adds dev positives outside the V6 500
admission_rules.second_level: fixed fusion and LightGBM both reported; LightGBM early-stopped on F_{j+1}
admission_rules.multimodal_claim: 'multimodal gain' may be claimed only if (i) late fusion beats the channel-only LightGBM and F7 on E1, (ii) paired permutations lower performance (E5), and (iii) the gain is not reproduced by the mask-only model or the raw concatenation

stopping_and_downgrade_rules: if the same-resource fixed fusion beats the learned gate, keep the fixed fusion
if coverage rises but top-10 falls, report pool change and squeezed-out hits, do not claim
if permutation leaves a modality's effect unchanged, report it as not used
if the anchor stage gives no dev gain, report lambda_A = 0 as the selected configuration
the title contains 'multimodal' only if the multimodal_claim rule is met

fit_budget.main_chain: 5 folds x 3 seeds x (3 inner + 1 outer) = 60 core fits
fit_budget.variant_chains: seed 42: core_altanchor, two_tower, core_oldres, core_strict = 4 x 20 = 80 fits
fit_budget.outer_only: seed 42: core_bgctrl, core_image, core_mouse (if admitted) = 15 fits
fit_budget.second_level: LightGBM late fusion 15, channel-only LightGBM 15, E2/E4/E5 variants seed 42 x 5 folds

confirmation_set.evaluation: filtered: each method's ranked list minus the disease's CTD positives; pool misses count as misses
